# Fund Notes Resumption of Loan-Financed Works

NEW VELDRANIA — The Fund's regional office "took note" of Kunasai's decision to resume the Great Sanitation Works, financed by the loan whose interest now dominates the country's budget. Fund officials declined to say whether the March review mission would examine the Corvel contract.
